faq.title: FAQ
faq.question1: How will the auction be conducted?
faq.answer1: For the first time, an item of this caliber will be available to retail investors through our fractional ownership mechanism. The auction won't offer the entire object, but rather its FCC, divided into 200 lots, each containing different quantities of ownership shares, which we call fractions.
faq.answer2: This is a special type of crypto certificate - Fractional Crypto Certificate - that we created for precise identification of physical assets, enabling their almost instant resale, similar to the NFT market. FCC also provides the ability to own 'fractions' as shares of expensive assets.
faq.question3: What kind of expertise is required?
faq.answer3: There are several respected institutions and specialists in the world who can verify the authenticity of works from Karl Fabergé's workshop. We're currently in dialogue with two of them. We'll share all the details in our social media channels.
faq.question4: How can I manage my ownership shares?
faq.answer4: On our CoArt Marketplace, you'll be able to sell and resell both unique physical objects in their entirety and ownership shares of them as 'fractions' of specific FCCs.
faq.question5: Where will the Egg itself be stored?
faq.answer5: After the auction concludes, the object itself will be exhibited in one of the European museums or transferred for safekeeping to one of the specialized 'freeports'.
